name: center-feedback-suppression
description: Verify combat feedback avoids unbounded center-screen and world-damage overlays while rejected actions remain visible in the current bounded feedback-holder queue.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke('Reset') c:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=15,Coins=0,WallLevel=1,Rebirths=0,CritChance=0,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0}) local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-2,3,-20),Vector3.new(-2,3,-80)) p:SetAttribute('LastWallHit',0) local punch=c:Invoke('PunchRadius') local rejected=c:Invoke('Rebirth') return H:JSONEncode({punch=punch.ok==true,rejection=rejected.reason,rejected=rejected.ok==false})

steps.label: trigger combat feedback and an authoritative rejected action

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local gui=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local function inspect(holder) local visible=0 local bounded=true local left,top=holder.AbsolutePosition.X,holder.AbsolutePosition.Y local right,bottom=left+holder.AbsoluteSize.X,top+holder.AbsoluteSize.Y for _,d in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do if d:IsA('GuiObject') and d.Visible and d.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and d.AbsoluteSize.Y>0 then visible+=1 local dl,dt=d.AbsolutePosition.X,d.AbsolutePosition.Y local dr,db=dl+d.AbsoluteSize.X,dt+d.AbsoluteSize.Y bounded=bounded and dl>=left-2 and dt>=top-2 and dr<=right+2 and db<=bottom+2 end end local limit=tonumber(holder:GetAttribute('MaxVisibleItems')) or 0 local tracked=holder:GetAttribute('VisibleItemCount') local countSynced=(tracked==nil and visible==0) or tracked==visible return visible,bounded and visible<=limit,countSynced,holder:GetAttribute('PresentationMode'),limit end local toasts,toastBounded,toastCountSynced,toastMode,toastLimit=inspect(gui.Toasts) local rewards,rewardBounded,rewardCountSynced,rewardMode,rewardLimit=inspect(gui.RewardPops) local center,damage=0,0 for _,d in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do if d.Name=='CombatDamageBurst' or d.Name=='CombatImpactCore' or d.Name=='CombatSparkRays' then center+=1 end end for _,d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do if d.Name=='LocalDamageNumber' then damage+=1 end end local lastType=gui:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackType') local presented=gui.Toasts.Visible and toasts>0 local valid=gui:GetAttribute('CenterActionFeedbackEnabled')==false and presented and toastBounded and rewardBounded and toastCountSynced and rewardCountSynced and toastMode=='BoundedVisibleQueueV1' and rewardMode=='BoundedVisibleQueueV1' and toastLimit==3 and rewardLimit==3 and center==0 and damage==0 and lastType=='Fail' return H:JSONEncode({valid=valid,enabled=gui:GetAttribute('CenterActionFeedbackEnabled'),toastHolder=gui.Toasts.Visible,toasts=toasts,toastBounded=toastBounded,toastCountSynced=toastCountSynced,rewardHolder=gui.RewardPops.Visible,rewards=rewards,rewardBounded=rewardBounded,rewardCountSynced=rewardCountSynced,toastMode=toastMode,rewardMode=rewardMode,toastLimit=toastLimit,rewardLimit=rewardLimit,center=center,damage=damage,feedback=gui:GetAttribute('FeedbackCount') or 0,lastType=lastType,presented=presented})

steps.label: bounded feedback remains visible without unbounded center overlays
